attchmntText: Arcotech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Arcotech Limited approved its standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board met on 14th November 2026. The company reported a loss of 917.23 lakhs for the quarter and 1,732.79 lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations was 0.02 lakhs for both periods. Finance costs were 559.58 lakhs for the quarter and 1,119.48 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were negative 0.87 rupees for the quarter and negative 1.65 rupees for the half year. Total assets stood at 26,809.80 lakhs as of 30th September 2026. The company entered settlement agreements with secured lenders as of 1st July 2026. The results were reviewed by the statutory auditors.
